decisions.diagnosis: The South East (citybound) sensor channel under-counted intermittently while the North West direction and the Anzac Bridge counter stayed normal, so bikes were lost rather than moved between directions.
decisions.evidence: Weekly 67/68 ratio is 1.10 median (IQR 1.03-1.16) in all other years but falls to 0.28-0.58 from mid-Oct 2018 (e.g. wk 2018-10-15 136 vs 489); 68/Anzac ratio unchanged at ~0.12-0.15, 67/Anzac falls from ~0.14 to ~0.05; onset 2018-10-03 with daily ratio sliding from ~1.1 to ~0.2.

decisions.diagnosis: Same intermittent South East under-count, back after a month of normal readings.
decisions.evidence: Weekly 67/68 ratio 0.61-0.84 with days as low as 0.16-0.33 (e.g. 2019-07-04 to 07-08 10-16 bikes vs 43-82), against a normal ~1.1.

decisions.diagnosis: The South East under-count returned and persisted until the counter went offline in March 2020; after the 2021 restart the direction split is normal again.
decisions.evidence: Weekly 67/68 ratio 0.18-0.81, mostly 0.3-0.6 (e.g. wk 2020-03-09 214 vs 706); from May 2021 ratio is back to 1.0-1.08.

decisions.diagnosis: The North West direction lost most of its evening peak for a week, while the South East direction was normal; this could be a sensor fault or a real evening diversion, since Anzac Bridge westbound also fell about 25% on the same days.
decisions.evidence: 68 weekday totals 15-39 vs 57-81 the week before (17:00 hour mean 3.8 vs 18.4), 67 normal at 78-98; Anzac dir 6 503-603 vs dir 5 726-745.

summary: Single Metrocount piezo on the Iron Cove Bridge NE shared path with continuous data from 2012 to 2026, apart from a gap from March 2020 to May 2021. The South East (citybound) direction under-counted intermittently from October 2018 to March 2020 while the North West direction and the nearby Anzac Bridge counter read normally. That period is set to missing apart from two stretches in May and July-August 2019 where it read normally. Other anomalies look real and are kept: the March 2014 dips are daytime path closures for works, with riders still counted outside work hours; the February 2013 surge also shows at Anzac Bridge and the SW Iron Cove counter; and the automatic fixes, including the 2022-02-19 halving, are correct.
